description: This file manages cron jobs by reading, writing, and locking crontab entries, interfacing with storage, and handling system calls for updating cron configurations.

methods.name: getCronRootLockFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the cron root lock file, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getCronRootFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the cron root file, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getCronUpdateFilePath
methods.description: Returns the path to the cron update file, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: createCronUpdateFile
methods.description: Creates or updates the cron update file, depending on the platform.

methods.name: parseFromStorage
methods.description: Parses crontab entries from storage into a hash map.

methods.name: saveCrontab
methods.description: Saves the current crontab entries to the crontab file and triggers an update.

methods.name: releaseFileLock
methods.description: Releases the file lock and unlocks the lock file.

methods.name: releaseFileLockOnSig
methods.description: Handles signal to release lock and re-raises the signal.

methods.name: getFileLock
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a file lock with retries, setting up signal handling.

methods.name: addOrUpdatePreformattedCrontabEntry
methods.description: Adds or updates a crontab entry in storage and updates the crontab file.

methods.name: removeCrontabEntry
methods.description: Removes a crontab entry from storage and updates the crontab file.

methods.name: hasCrontabEntry
methods.description: Checks if a crontab entry exists and matches a given line.
